description:
Modding platform for GI, HSR, WW and ZZZ

Features
  One Ring — Allows to launch and manage all supported Model Importers in unified and convenient way
  Plug-and-Play — Configures any supported game and installs its XXMI instance automatically
  Custom Launch — Can be configured to start game in almost every possible way via Advanced Settings
  Automatic Updates — Always keeps XXMI instances and itself up-to date
  Safe to Use — Verifies authenticity of XXMI libraries and own downloads
Supported Model Importers
  WWMI - Wuthering Waves Model Importer GitHub
  ZZMI - Zenless Zone Zero Model Importer GitHub
  SRMI - Honkai: Star Rail Model Importer GitHub
  GIMI - Genshin Impact Model Importer GitHubs
**Available Editions** ([Installation Guide](https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Launcher?tab=readme-ov-file#installation)):
• For **Native Windows App** mode download `.msi` installer.
• For **Portable** **or** **Linux** setup download `.zip` version.

[![Support on Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-PATREON-orange?logo=patreon&logoColor=white)](https://www.patreon.com/SpectrumQT)

## Additions
• **[Launcher]:** Added **`--silent_update`** command-line option to automatically install available updates in `--nogui` mode.
• **[XXMI]:** Added **Manage XXMI DLL Config** option to control whether `d3dx.ini` is written on game launch.
• **[Launcher]:** Added support for proxying unknown command-line arguments to the game process.
• **[GUI]:** Added animated images playback support (`.apng`, `.avif`, `.gif`, and `.webp`).

## Adjustments
• **[Launcher]:** Ensure the game is closed before running update.
• **[XXMI]:** Prevent XXMI DLL-exclusive options from being written to `d3dx.ini` when using a non-XXMI DLL.
• **[SRMI]:** Added **Game Launch - Direct** compatibility for EGS HSR.

## Improvements
• **[GUI]:** Improved GUI scaling support.

## Bugfixes
• **[WWMI]:** Fixed `Wuthering Waves.exe` auto-detection failure when there's duplicate in `launcherDownload` folder.
• **[WWMI]:** Fixed automatic MI type detection from the game executable command-line argument failing for `Wuthering Waves.exe`.
• **[XXMI]:** Fixed **XXMI DLL** not being immediately deployed by the MI repair operation.
• **[Launcher]:** Fixed `XXMI Launcher.exe` command line arguments backslashes handling.
• **[GUI]:** Fixed message chaining getting stuck in `--nogui` mode.
• **[GUI]:** Fixed minor GUI glitches and issues.
